# Third-party reference code

`spectralformer/` contains upstream source (`vit_pytorch.py` plus a minimal `einops`
shim) retrieved for reimplementation reference, with `provenance.json` recording where
it came from and `UPSTREAM_README.md` recording the upstream documentation.

It is **not** part of this repository's implementation and is covered by its own
upstream license. SpectralFormer has not yet been run under the governed protocols
here; see the limitations section of the top-level `README.md`.
